_comment: Parameters for the dev stack (sepsis-dev). Use a separate AWS account per environment. Budget and alert emails come from BUDGET_EMAIL / ALERT_EMAIL. TrainingBackend=ecs runs the pipeline steps as ECS Fargate tasks (no SageMaker training quota needed). MlflowBackend=ecs hosts MLflow on ECS (RDS PostgreSQL, S3 artifacts); EnableSageMakerMlflowApp=false removes the SageMaker MLflow App (set it back to true to switch back).
